constraints.text: Ship every specified task as its own PR, based on main, from your own worktree made with git worktree add off origin/main (<aitools>/.scratch/worktrees/874d-2-structured-reports), on the branch feature/874d-2-structured-reports-<specified task id in lowercase> (for example feature/874d-2-structured-reports-st874d-1); a later specified task's branch merges the earlier one in with --no-ff. Start each PR title with its specified task's id and each commit subject with its batch id (ST874d-1.1). Commit and push after every batch, with git commit -F.

Do not merge: the commander merges the PRs, in order. Hand back your AAR when every specified task's PR is open with CI green, or at once when a blocker stops you, with a recommended course of action. This overrides the /delegate duty to self-merge (D-DEL6: the brief ranks above the skill).

Never push to main, force-push, or approve your own PR. Update the plan's status table after each batch in the specified task's branch (D874d-60); do not write .aitools/channel/relay.md, a direct-to-main file.
Launch an independent reviewer (a delegate that did not see your notes) for every PR; its verdict is a PR comment before the PR goes to the commander.

Before every push run bash scripts/check-pre-commit.sh and bash scripts/check-pre-push.sh (on Windows the .ps1 twins with pwsh -NoProfile -File). Every new test suite gets a step in each job of .github/workflows/check.yml that runs it; watch CI until it passes on macOS, Linux and Windows.

ST874d-1 starts on your launch order (gate G0). ST874d-2 needs G0 and gate G1, the six working-copy files of session dbd05b0c on origin/main; G1 is met (commit 311ad1ff, 2026-11-16). ST874d-3 to ST874d-6 follow in order. The ids are not the order; the plan's Gates section is.
Do not reopen the decisions of issue #180 section 1 or of session 86d6da03 (RFC 0011 appendix A); a point you find unclear goes to the commander as an RFI with a suggested answer.
Python is standard library only, at the floor scripts/harness-db.py states (Python 3.10 or later).
A new or widened hook check starts in observe mode and passes the syntax, smoke and violation tests of .claude/rules/hook-rollout.md.
Never run aitools, aitools install, setup-user-*, deploy-harness or scripts/build-deploy.sh against the real HOME; tests use an isolated HOME.
Never open a live session DB or the harness DB with a branch's or worktree's harness-db.py: tests and probes use throwaway copies (sqlite3 backup API).
Never push to the real dotprofile: tests use a clone whose origin is a local bare repo in your scratch, checked before every push (git remote get-url origin must not contain github.com).

Never commit a mission brief, an AAR, a running-estimate export, or a harvested copy of one (harvesting/*-brief.json, harvesting/*-aar.json), to a project repo, except a brief the commander orders into the briefs directory, as he ordered this one (D874d-71 to D874d-74). The briefs of your batch delegates stay in the session scratch directory. How a new version of a brief in the briefs directory reaches main is deferred by the commander (D874d-76): until he decides, it reaches main through a PR, unless he orders otherwise for that change (RFC 0011 3.3.1a). Citing the commander's decisions in rules, references and the glossary is allowed, as the repo already does.

This brief is a long-lifecycle brief in the briefs directory. On the commander's order it keeps the provenance of session dbd05b0c, where it was written, when another session carries the mission out, and the session agent of that session may carry it out itself, with no delegate (D0036-2; RFC 0011 3.3.1a). Whoever carries it out reports to the agent that launched it, or, when it is the session agent itself, to the commander in its own session.

Change the glossary only in batch ST874d-2.2 and only through /glossary; add no glossary entries for the schema's nodes and fields (D874d-66). The terms specified task and ST are already governed (session 86d6da03, D0036-3).

Read every file in full before you change it. The files marked 'use as reference for answers' in artifacts are what you need to brief the delegates of your batches; give each such delegate its batch's files as 'read in full' artifacts, in a brief written by RFC 0011 3.3 into the top-level session's scratch directory, the default location (RFC 0011 3.3.1).

Where the deployed /delegate (~/.claude/skills/delegate/SKILL.md) differs from the aitools working copy (shared/skills/delegate/SKILL.md) or from RFC 0011, follow RFC 0011 and issue #180 (D-DEL6: the commander's newest words).

operational_learning.text: The deployed /delegate (~/.claude/skills/delegate/SKILL.md) can be older than the aitools working copy (shared/skills/delegate/SKILL.md v2.6), and RFC 0011 and issue #180 are newer than both; where they differ, follow the commander's newest words (D-DEL6)

A delegate's subagents/agent-<agentId>.meta.json, whose description starts with its mission name, existed while the four background verifiers 874d-3 to 874d-6 ran (2026-11-16); for 874d-1-aar-doctrine it was seen only at finish, a file time that is rewritten then. Look for it first; fall back to a TaskStop error or the parent transcript

ait-harvest.py archive copies transcripts into the dotprofile and commits and pushes them, detached, because Claude Code gives SessionEnd hooks a 1.5-second default window; but it takes no lock, and ~/.aitools/logs/ait-harvest.log holds about 60 git failures, mostly index.lock contention. RFC 0011 3.5.5 requires one detached job with a lock and a rebase

A schema-4 harness-db.py crashes on a schema-5 DB: migrate_v4 runs before the version check, and on a throwaway DB the probe hit 'use DROP VIEW to delete view observations'. Batch 3.0 ships the version check first

source.location: mission 874d-4-adversarial OBS-1 (probe on a throwaway DB, SQLite 3.53.1)

operational_learning.text: Another session can edit the same working-copy files at the same time (commit 3893c908 staged only its own lines with git update-index); run git log and git diff on a shared file before editing it
The 10-character session id prefix includes the UUID's first hyphen (dbd05b0c-2.db)

The harvester copies every non-ephemeral top-level file of a session scratch directory into the tracked harvesting/ of a public repo; *.json files are ephemeral only when named package-lock*, node_modules*, tsconfig* or *.config.json. Until batch 4.5 ships, save copies of transcripts, prompts and issue bodies as *.tmp
A message the commander sends while a turn is running is recorded in the transcript as a queue-operation record with a content field, not as a user record; a quote check must read both
A GitHub issue body holds at most 65,536 characters; issue #180 moved sections to comments in v5.1 and v5.4

source.location: session dbd05b0c, issue #180 v5.1 and v5.4

operational_learning.text: A mechanical schema check (keys, enums, quotes) passed the v1.0 brief completely; every substantive defect came from reading its constraints and access against the repo's rules. Pair any validate step with a sufficiency read

chrome-devtools evaluate_script with filePath saves its output with a .json extension, which the harvester copies into the tracked harvesting/ of a public repo; rename such an extract to .tmp at once (OL-7)
